A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] '''sniper''' was the previous owner of [[Larin Moxla]]'s [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. The [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].
